---
title: Smoke report
---

Quarto cells. The language server answers inside each cell (hover, diagnostics) when Zed attaches
it to the Quarto language. The second cell has attributes after its language.

```{avenger-sql}
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS k, 1 AS v)])
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => k, y => v, title => '*Bold* title') AS chart
```

```{avenger-sql echo=false}
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('b' AS k, 2 AS v)])
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => k, y => v, title => title('_Italic_ title', subtitle => 'sub')) AS chart
```
